aubergine-canvas.$description: Aubergine Canvas — Page background, primary canvas — warm-tinted dark replaces pure black so the UI feels layered rather than flat

elevated-plum.$description: Elevated Plum — Card surfaces, input fields, nav containers — one step lighter than canvas to create depth without a visible border

pure-white.$description: Pure White — Primary headings, button text, icon strokes — maximum contrast on the dark canvas

fog-text.$description: Fog Text — Body text, secondary headings, muted borders — sits at 7:1 contrast for comfortable reading on the aubergine canvas

ash-text.$description: Ash Text — Supporting neutral for secondary UI, dividers, and muted labels. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

mist-highlight.$description: Mist Highlight — Subtle borders, dividers, inactive nav items — the faintest neutral that still reads against canvas

whisper-border.$description: Whisper Border — Hairline highlights on dark surfaces, inset strokes — a near-white that reads as a light edge in dark mode

coral-ember.$description: Coral Ember — Orange supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

iris-accent.$description: Iris Accent — Secondary headings, decorative violet text — a muted blue-violet that harmonizes with the aubergine canvas without competing with coral

sans-serif.$description: sans-serif — detected in extracted data but not described by AI

haffer-xh-semibold.$description: Primary display and heading font. Used at 70–88px for hero headlines with -0.02em tracking, weight 600. The tight tracking and high x-height give headlines an editorial weight that makes the dark interface feel like a magazine cover rather than a dashboard. Substitute with Inter Tight or General Sans at semibold weight.

jersey-10.$description: Oversized decorative display font for accent numerals and feature callouts. Used sparingly at very large sizes to create typographic moments. Substitute with Anybody or Cabinet Grotesk display weight.

inter.$description: Body text, navigation, links, form inputs. Inter at weight 400 with negative tracking (-0.01em to -0.02em) keeps body copy compact and legible on the dark canvas. Weight 500 for emphasized inline text and button labels.

satoshi.$description: Medium-weight accent for testimonial quotes and emphasized body segments. Sits between Inter 400 and Haffer 600 to create a three-tier type hierarchy without switching families mid-paragraph. Substitute with General Sans Medium.

haffer-xh-semibold-italic.$description: Italic emphasis for quoted phrases and inline highlights within body copy. Used to set apart key terms without changing font family. Substitute with Inter Tight SemiBold Italic.

customblender-medium.$description: CUSTOM;Blender Medium — detected in extracted data but not described by AI
